properties.name: Eloy / Casa Grande
properties.story: The long sink. Agricultural land and growing communities share the aquifer beneath the lower Santa Cruz Valley. This is our first site for comparing satellite ground motion with ADWR observations.
properties.source: Project-defined study extent; not a subsidence boundary.

properties.name: Buckeye / Goodyear
properties.story: The new pressure. The West Valley brings agriculture, expanding communities and data-center development into the same landscape. We compare where change is occurring without assigning responsibility for ground movement to individual water users.
properties.source: Project-defined study extent; not ADWR's northern West Valley feature.

properties.name: Willcox
properties.story: The playa and the cranes. Agricultural land and seasonal habitat share the Willcox basin. This study connects measured ground motion with separately mapped habitat; radar does not observe wildlife.
properties.source: Project-defined study extent; not a habitat or subsidence boundary.
